verdict.rationale: A community user confirms Helicone lets them see each request and export them all. A documented REST endpoint (POST /v1/request/query) allows programmatic retrieval of logged requests, and self-hosting lets users run their own instance. However, no first-party doc describes a full account export, which formats are used (CSV/JSON/etc.), or coverage of prompts, sessions and other data beyond requests. Missing for 10: documented bulk export of all data types, explicit open export formats, a first-party account-exit/data-portability guide.
